H05-VAG: SELECT tx7n.c01 AS flight_id, tu5q.c02 AS aircraft, tumf.c02 AS model, SUM(tx7n.c13) AS total_distance FROM tx7n JOIN tu5q ON tx7n.c04 = tu5q.c01 JOIN tumf ON tu5q.c04 = tumf.c01 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY tx7n.c01 ORDER BY total_distance ASC

H08-CAS: SELECT tu5q.c02 AS aircraft_model, COUNT(tx7n.c01) AS completed_flights_more_than_half_full FROM tu5q JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 JOIN t89v ON tx7n.c01 = t89v.c01 JOIN trhn ON t89v.c07 = trhn.c01 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' AND t89v.c14 > trhn.c06 * 0.5 GROUP BY tu5q.c02
H08-SCH: SELECT t2.c02, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights FROM tg6t AS t1 JOIN tx7n AS t2 ON t1.c03 = t2.c01 JOIN t89v AS t3 ON t1.c02 = t3.c01 JOIN t3z7 AS t4 ON t1.c03 = t4.c03 AND t1.c02 = t4.c02 WHERE t2.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY t2.c02 HAVING SUM(t3.c14) > 0.5 * t2.c08
H08-BIZ: SELECT tumf.c02 AS aircraft_type, COUNT(tx7n.c01) AS completed_flights FROM tx7n JOIN tumf ON tx7n.c04 = tumf.c01 JOIN tu5q ON tx7n.c04 = tu5q.c01 JOIN t89v ON tx7n.c01 = t89v.c01 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY tumf.c02 HAVING SUM(t89v.c14) / SUM(t89v.c13) > 0.5
H08-VAG: SELECT tumf.c02 AS model_name, (t875.c15 / tumf.c07) AS weight_ratio FROM tu5q JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 JOIN t875 ON tx7n.c01 = t875.c03 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' ORDER BY weight_ratio ASC LIMIT 1
H09-CAS: SELECT tu5q.c01 FROM tu5q JOIN ts53 ON tu5q.c06 = ts53.c01 WHERE ts53.c14 = 1 GROUP BY tu5q.c01 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ts53.c01) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ts53 WHERE c14 = 1)
H09-SCH: SELECT ts53.c02 FROM tx7n JOIN ts53 ON tx7n.c06 = ts53.c01 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' AND ts53.c14 = 1 GROUP BY ts53.c02 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ts53.c01) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ts53 WHERE c14 = 1)
H09-BIZ: SELECT tu5q.c02, tu5q.c04 FROM tu5q JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY tu5q.c02, tu5q.c04 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tx7n.c05) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ts53 WHERE c07 IN (SELECT c07 FROM twxv WHERE c11 = 1))
H09-VAG: SELECT tu5q.c02, COUNT(DISTINCT tx7n.c06) AS unique_airports_visited FROM tu5q JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY tu5q.c02 ORDER BY unique_airports_visited DESC
H10-CAS: SELECT t3v5.c06, COUNT(*) FROM t3v5 JOIN t89v ON t3v5.c03 = t89v.c01 JOIN trhn ON t3v5.c04 = trhn.c01 WHERE (t3v5.c09 + t3v5.c11) / t3v5.c09 > 1.2 GROUP BY t3v5.c06
H10-SCH: SELECT c06, COUNT(*) FROM t3v5 WHERE c05 = 'import' AND c11 + c12 > 0.2 * c09 GROUP BY c06
H10-BIZ: SELECT t89v.c06, COUNT(t3v5.c01) AS entry_count FROM t3v5 JOIN t89v ON t3v5.c03 = t89v.c01 JOIN trhn ON t3v5.c04 = trhn.c01 WHERE t3v5.c10 > 20 GROUP BY t89v.c06
H10-VAG: SELECT ts4p.c02 AS country, SUM(t3v5.c11) AS total_duty_to_pay FROM t3v5 JOIN ts4p ON t3v5.c10 = ts4p.c01 WHERE t3v5.c05 = 'import' GROUP BY ts4p.c02 ORDER BY total_duty_to_pay DESC
